# Docsify

No build step. One `index.html` sets `window.$docsify = {...}` and loads Docsify plus plugin `<script>`s; the browser fetches each page's raw Markdown and renders it. Navigation is Markdown (`_sidebar.md`, `_navbar.md`).

## Detect

- An `index.html` with an inline `window.$docsify = {` and a `<script src=".../docsify...">`, usually in `docs/`. That folder is the content root.
- `_sidebar.md`, `_navbar.md`, `_coverpage.md`, `.nojekyll`, `README.md` beside it; `docsify-cli` in `package.json` or `docsify serve` in scripts.
- Live site: URLs of the form `/#/page`, and `<site>/README.md` returns raw Markdown.
- `index.html` with `$docsify` wins. A GitHub wiki (`_Sidebar.md`, `Home.md`, no `index.html`) is not Docsify.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Read all of `index.html` first. The `$docsify` object decides which files are nav (`loadSidebar`, `loadNavbar`, `coverpage` can name other files), which file is home (`homepage`, default `README.md`), and where content comes from (`basePath`, `alias`). Every `<script src>` is a plugin to map.
- Every `.md` under the content root is a candidate page; files only reached through `:include` are partials, not pages.
- Nested sidebars: each folder may have its own `_sidebar.md`/`_navbar.md`; Docsify falls back to the parent folder's file. Collect all of them.
- Locales are plain subfolders (`zh-cn/README.md`, `zh-cn/guide.md`), usually linked from `_navbar.md`.
- Remote content: a `homepage`, `basePath` or `alias` pointing at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/...` means the page lives in another repo. Vendor a copy and report it.

### From an export

None; the site is served from the repo files.

### From the live site

Docsify serves the raw files, so fetch them directly. Route `/#/guide` → `<site><basePath>guide.md`; `/#/folder/` → `folder/README.md`; nav from `<site>/_sidebar.md` and `<site>/_navbar.md`. Respect `basePath` and `ext` from the live `index.html`.

| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name` (strip HTML; `true` = `<title>` of `index.html`)                                                                                                                                                                                        | `name`                                                                          |
| `<meta name="description">` in `index.html`                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `description`                                                                   |
| `logo`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `logo`                                                                          |
| `nameLink`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `logo.href` (per-locale objects: drop and report)                               |
| `<link rel="icon">` in `index.html`                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `favicon`                                                                       |
| `themeColor` (deprecated) or `--theme-color` CSS variable                                                                                                                                                                                      | `colors.primary`                                                                |
| `repo`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `navbar.links` entry with `type: "github"`                                      |
| `_navbar.md`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | see Navigation                                                                  |
| `formatUpdated`, `{docsify-updated}`                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `metadata.timestamp: true` only if the user wants dates; delete the placeholder |
| `notFoundPage`, `_404.md`                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | drop and report (`errors.404` holds only redirect/title/description)            |
| `alias` local → local                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `redirects`                                                                     |
| `alias` to sidebar/navbar files (`'/.*/_sidebar.md'`)                                                                                                                                                                                          | drop                                                                            |
| `routes` (virtual routes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | static string routes → pages; function routes → drop and report                 |
| `fallbackLanguages`, `fallbackDefaultLanguage`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | drop and report                                                                 |
| `loadSidebar`, `loadNavbar`, `coverpage`, `onlyCover`, `homepage`                                                                                                                                                                              | drop; use to locate files                                                       |
| `routerMode`, `relativePath`, `basePath`, `ext`                                                                                                                                                                                                | drop; use to compute old URLs and resolve links                                 |
| `subMaxLevel`, `maxLevel`, `auto2top`, `topMargin`, `mergeNavbar`, `externalLinkTarget`, `cornerExternalLinkTarget`, `collapseSidebarGroups`, `hideSidebar`, `sidebarPosition`, `keyBindings`, `requestHeaders`, `noEmoji`, `markdown` options | drop                                                                            |
| `markdown.renderer` overrides                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | drop and report what they rendered                                              |

| Plugin `search`, `docsify-copy-code`, `zoom-image`, `docsify-pagination`                                                                                                                                                                       | drop (built into Mintlify)                                                      |

| Theme CSS, custom stylesheets                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | drop and report                                                                 |

## Navigation

- `_sidebar.md` is a nested Markdown list. A list item with a link is a page; a list item with plain text and child items is a group header. Map: header → group, linked item → page path, nested list under a linked item → nested group with that page as `root`. Keep order and labels.
- Label differs from the page H1 → `sidebarTitle`. Link title string (`[Guide](guide.md "Tab title")`) set only the browser tab title: drop and report.
- Resolve link targets: strip `.md`, `README` → folder index file, `/` → home page. Links resolve from the content root unless `relativePath: true`.
- External links in the sidebar → a page with frontmatter `title` + `url: <href>`, listed at that position.
- A folder-level `_sidebar.md` replaces the sidebar for that folder: map that folder to its own tab with its own groups.
- `_navbar.md`: top-level links to doc sections → `navigation.tabs`; a text item with a nested list → a tab with `menu` or, when the children are locales (`/`, `/zh-cn/`), `navigation.languages`; external links → `navbar.links`.
- The home page (`README.md` or `homepage`) goes first. Pages not in any sidebar were reachable only by link (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- `_sidebar.md`, `_navbar.md`, `_coverpage.md`, `_404.md` are not pages: do not convert them.

## Content conversion

Pages usually have no front matter (the `front-matter` plugin is optional). If content precedes the first H1, use the sidebar label as title (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter).

| Docsify                                                                                         | Mintlify                                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `> [!NOTE]` / `[!TIP]` / `[!IMPORTANT]` / `[!WARNING]` / `[!CAUTION]`                           | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, GitHub alerts                                    |
| `!> text` (legacy important)                                                                    | `<Info>`                                                                            |
| `?> text` (legacy tip)                                                                          | `<Tip>`                                                                             |
| `## Heading :id=custom-id`                                                                      | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs                                      |
| `<!-- {docsify-ignore} -->`, `{docsify-ignore}`, `{docsify-ignore-all}` on headings             | delete                                                                              |
| `[x](file.md ':include')` (Markdown)                                                            | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content                                 |
| `[x](file.js ':include :type=code')`, `:fragment=name`                                          | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports; fragments are `/// [name]` markers |
| `:include` of `.html` / `:type=iframe`                                                          | `<iframe>` inside `<Frame>`                                                         |
| `:include` of `.mp4`/`.ogg` / `.mp3`                                                            | `<video controls src>` / `<audio controls src>` with a root-relative path           |
| `:include` of a remote URL or gist                                                              | vendor the content; report                                                          |
| docsify-tabs `<!-- tabs:start -->`, `#### **Name**` or `<!-- tab:Name -->`, `<!-- tabs:end -->` | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title="Name">`                                                     |
| `<details><summary>T</summary>`                                                                 | `<Accordion title="T">`                                                             |
| `[x](/path ':ignore')`                                                                          | plain link to that path (it pointed outside the docs)                               |
| `[x](/path ':disabled')`                                                                        | plain text `x`                                                                      |
| `':target=_blank'`, `':class=...'`, `':id=...'` on links                                        | drop the attribute string                                                           |
| `![a](img.png ':size=WxH')` / `':size=N'`                                                       | `<img src="/img.png" alt="a" width="W" height="H" />`                               |
| `![a](img.png ':no-zoom')`                                                                      | `<img ... noZoom />`                                                                |
| `:shortcode:` emoji                                                                             | Unicode emoji, unless `noEmoji: true` (then leave literal)                          |
| ` ```mermaid ` (custom renderer)                                                                | keep the fence                                                                      |
| `$...$` / `$$...$$` from a math plugin                                                          | keep                                                                                |
| Vue templates or `<script>` in pages                                                            | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components                                       |

## Assets

- Docsify serves every file in the content root at its path (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- Resolve each image path the way the live site did: open the rendered page and read the `<img src>` it produced, then map that to the new location. Do not assume `./`, `../` and `/` paths resolve from the content root.
- `_media/` is the conventional asset folder; keep its name so paths stay stable.
- Cover page background (`![](bg.png)` or `![color](#hex)` in `_coverpage.md`): drop and report.

## URLs and redirects

- Hash mode (default `routerMode: 'hash'`): every page is `/#/<path>`, folder index `/#/<folder>/`, home `/`. Heading anchors are `?id=<heading-id>` after the route (`/#/guide?id=install`).
- Hash URLs cannot be redirected (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects). Tell the user: old links load the new site root. If they need old links to resolve, a client-side script that reads `location.hash` and rewrites `#/<path>?id=<x>` to `/<new-path>#<x>` is the only option; it lives outside `docs.json` (a custom `.js` file in the Mintlify content directory runs on every page). Do not add it without the user's approval.
- History mode (`routerMode: 'history'`): URLs are real paths (`/guide`), so emit normal `redirects` for any path that changes. Anchors are still `?id=` and fall back to the page top (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- Pin `{#id}` on headings that old `?id=` links target, using the id Docsify rendered (read the heading `id` attributes on the live page, or the `:id=`).
- The `homepage` file is the `/` page.
- `alias` entries were routes too: redirect the alias path to the new page (history mode) or report it (hash mode).
- Locales keep folder prefixes (`/zh-cn/...`).
- `README.md` folder index files (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).

## Known gaps

Report each that the site uses:

- Hash-route URLs and `?id=` anchors (no server-side redirect).
- Cover page layout and background, `onlyCover`.
- Function `routes`, `alias` to remote content, `fallbackLanguages`.
- Vue components, `executeScript` page scripts, custom `markdown` renderers.
- Comment plugins (Disqus, Gitalk), Universal Analytics, third-party plugins without a mapping above.
- Per-heading sidebar TOC control (`subMaxLevel`, `docsify-ignore`).
- Link and image attributes dropped (`:target`, `:class`, `:id`).
- Theme CSS and sidebar link title strings.
